name: spedf_deadline_5
notes: Phase-0 standard v3 async_batch. 5 small reads (nr=8) submitted DESCENDING, 256-sector spacing (non-adjacent: q_sp_edf has no merge hook and the framework allows merges by default). All one SMALL_READ lane; deadline=arrival+1ms (bpf.c:11) so EDF order == arrival FIFO == submission order 103424..102400. Discriminates sp_edf EDF-FIFO from mq-deadline C-LOOK (would issue ascending 102400..103424). Sectors 102400-103424 avoid readahead/background zones seen in prior logs. First run doubles as the arrival-ns tie probe: equal-arrival ties would fall back to sector ASC (bpf.c:89-91) and flip the order.
